newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks rally at close on rate hopes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks rally at close on rate hopes.

text.p: Mexican stocks rallied at the close of trade on Tuesday on expectations that domestic interest rates will fall and help boost corporate earnings.

The leading IPC stock index had a preliminary close of 3,396.44 points, a gain of 85.37 points, or 2.58 percent. The stock index normally move,s slightly after the close of trade as late trades are registered.
